subtitle: A group journey for units of veterans who were exposed to combat events. Those who served together process their experiences together.
whatTitle: Processing combat experiences, together with your unit
forWhom: Veterans who were exposed to combat events during their service. Participants come as the unit they served with.
where: In Israel and abroad, depending on the track.
modelsIntro: Choose a track to see its workshops, in order.
hostingTitle: Hosted by communities around the world
hostCountries: Countries where communities have hosted a journey
moreIntro: Peace of Mind also includes individual therapy, and alongside it Metiv runs other programs.
moreVeteransDescription: Metiv group programs for veterans, reservists and their families.
moreFreeDescription: Free treatment programs and studies recruiting participants.
moreMigdalorDescription: For people recognized by the Ministry of Defense Rehabilitation Department, on referral from the department.
moreAdultsDescription: Individual therapy for ages 17 and over, in Jerusalem and on Zoom.
joinText: Registration is through an online form.
